ayahs.text: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ

tr.sahih: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
tr.pickthall: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.

ayahs.text: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ

tr.sahih: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
tr.pickthall: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.

ayahs.text: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ

tr.sahih: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
tr.pickthall: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ

tr.sahih: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.
tr.pickthall: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter,

ayahs.text: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ

tr.sahih: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
tr.pickthall: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not.

ayahs.text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ

tr.sahih: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
tr.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing.

ayahs.text: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ

tr.sahih: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
tr.pickthall: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,

ayahs.text: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ

tr.sahih: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
tr.pickthall: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.

ayahs.text: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ

tr.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
tr.pickthall: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.

ayahs.text: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ

tr.sahih: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
tr.pickthall: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.

ayahs.text: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ

tr.sahih: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
tr.pickthall: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water

ayahs.text: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ

tr.sahih: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
tr.pickthall: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose.

ayahs.text: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ

tr.sahih: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
tr.pickthall: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails,

ayahs.text: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ

tr.sahih: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
tr.pickthall: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

tr.sahih: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
tr.pickthall: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth?

ayahs.text: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

tr.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
tr.pickthall: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

tr.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
tr.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

ayahs.text: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

tr.sahih: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
tr.pickthall: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings.

ayahs.text: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
tr.pickthall: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity,

ayahs.text: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ

tr.sahih: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
tr.pickthall: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees.

ayahs.text: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

tr.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
tr.pickthall: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

tr.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
tr.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

ayahs.text: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

tr.sahih: Thamūd denied the warning.
tr.pickthall: (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings

ayahs.text: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ

tr.sahih: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
tr.pickthall: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness.

ayahs.text: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ

tr.sahih: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
tr.pickthall: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar.

ayahs.text: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ

tr.sahih: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
tr.pickthall: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar.

ayahs.text: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience;

ayahs.text: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ

tr.sahih: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
tr.pickthall: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed.

ayahs.text: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ

tr.sahih: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
tr.pickthall: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her).

ayahs.text: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

tr.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
tr.pickthall: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!

ayahs.text: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

tr.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
tr.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

ayahs.text: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

tr.sahih: The people of Lot denied the warning.
tr.pickthall: The folk of Lot rejected warnings.

ayahs.text: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ

tr.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night,

ayahs.text: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ

tr.sahih: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
tr.pickthall: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

tr.sahih: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
tr.pickthall: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

tr.sahih: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
tr.pickthall: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ

tr.sahih: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
tr.pickthall: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.

ayahs.text: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

tr.sahih: So taste My punishment and warning.
tr.pickthall: Now taste My punishment after My warnings!

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

tr.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
tr.pickthall: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ

tr.sahih: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
tr.pickthall: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh

ayahs.text: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ

tr.sahih: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
tr.pickthall: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.

ayahs.text: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

tr.sahih: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?
tr.pickthall: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures?

ayahs.text: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ

tr.sahih: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
tr.pickthall: Or say they: We are a host victorious?

ayahs.text: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ

tr.sahih: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
tr.pickthall: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee.

ayahs.text: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ

tr.sahih: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
tr.pickthall: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure).

ayahs.text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness..
tr.pickthall: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness.

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ

tr.sahih: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
tr.pickthall: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell.

ayahs.text: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ

tr.sahih: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
tr.pickthall: Lo! We have created every thing by measure.

ayahs.text: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ

tr.sahih: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
tr.pickthall: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye.

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

tr.sahih: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
tr.pickthall: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth?

ayahs.text: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

tr.sahih: And everything they did is in written records.
tr.pickthall: And every thing they did is in the scriptures,

ayahs.text: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ

tr.sahih: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
tr.pickthall: And every small and great thing is recorded.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
tr.pickthall: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers,

ayahs.text: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ

tr.sahih: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
tr.pickthall: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.
